name: StreetSync
summary:
StreetSync: MR Garage is a cutting-edge mixed reality car simulator that lets you control and interact with vehicles from RC scale to full size—right in your own space. With realistic car physics, dynamic engine sounds, and intuitive controls layered onto your real environment, you can test your parking skills, drive through your surroundings, and customize your ride in immersive new ways.

🏎️ Control cars using Meta Quest controllers
🏙️ Real-world floor detection for lifelike MR driving
🎨 Customize car
